title: Book Three · Chapter 121: The Same Bus
story:
On the next Saturday, Ronan and Anna walk through the park after lunch.

The air is warmer now. Anna carries her jacket over one arm. Ronan has his football in a cloth bag.

They stop beside the quiet field. Two younger children are chasing a ball near the far end.

Anna tells him about the display. One student asked about the covered yard. The teacher wants her to keep the original drawings.

“For the course?” Ronan asks.

“Perhaps. I want to try some more first.”

He nods. Then he asks about the city on the bus board.

“Is that still the place?”

“It is one place. I want to find out about others too.”

Ronan moves the bag to his other hand.

“I keep seeing us on that bus,” he says.

Anna looks at him.

“For a visit?”

“For longer.”

She is quiet for a moment.

“Do you want to study building design?”

He looks across the field. He liked the paper room and the explanation. He cannot picture himself at a drawing table every day.

“I don't know. Not all of it.”

Anna looks toward the field too. A child is trying to carry a ball under each arm.

“What did you like about the little room?” she asks.

“Showing the door. They could see it hit the table.”

“More than making the drawing?”

Ronan thinks about Kai's box. Kai made the corners fit. The other boy kept the plan still. Ronan liked his turn at the front. At first, he was nervous.

“I liked the questions too,” he says. “Even the silly one.”

“About the smaller table?”

“Yes. I could give an answer.”

Anna smiles and listens. Ronan does not have to choose a course today.

The child drops one ball and runs after it. Ronan catches himself following it with his eyes. For a little while, choosing his whole future seems much harder than answering a question about a paper door.

He turns back to Anna. She is still waiting to hear his words.

Anna nods slowly.

“I do want that work. I still need to find the right course.”

“I thought we could find something in one place.”

“We don't know your something yet.”

He smiles a little at that. She takes his free hand.

“I want to hear about it,” she says. “When you find more information.”

“Even if it has no drawings?”

“You can always draw another shoe.”

He laughs. Then they walk to the low wall and sit down.

Ronan takes the ball out. He rolls it a little way with his foot. Anna stops it with the side of her shoe and sends it back.

For several minutes, they pass it between them. She misses once and gets up to fetch it. He watches her run after the ball in the spring light.

He still wants her beside him. He also wants an answer about his own next step. At present, he has questions and Leo's letter about a shelf.

Anna brings the ball back.

“Your turn to miss.”

He tries to stop her next pass. It rolls behind his heel.

“Very polite,” she says.

Ronan gets up and collects it before it reaches the path. When he returns, she has moved her jacket to make room on the wall again.

He sits beside her and puts the ball safely between his feet.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

original＝原稿、原来的；at present＝目前；heel＝脚后跟；fetch＝去拿回来。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan脑中常出现怎样的画面？Anna问的哪个问题让他看见自己还没想清楚的地方？
2. 这次谈话是否让Anna放弃自己的方向？谈话后两人实际做了什么？

## 读句子

**She takes his free hand.**

拆开看：She / takes / his free hand.

她／牵住／他没有拎袋子的那只手。
